description: Promet ovlaštenih mjenjača is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Hrvatska narodna banka. According to the data collected from the summary reports on the turnover of authorised currency exchange offices issued by the contractual banks, pursuant to Article 13(18). Coverage: Hrvatska narodna banka. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic of authorised exchange offices" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Hrvatska narodna banka. Its keywords include promet ovlaštenih mjenjača. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
